arm_contracts.cold: Frozen model with no acquisition memory or installed capability.
arm_contracts.raw_memory: Frozen model with raw acquisition repair traces available as memory, without executable capability activation or verifier gating.
arm_contracts.always_on: Frozen model with the same acquisition-derived executable capability used by VERIFIED, forcibly active on every protected task.
arm_contracts.verified: Frozen model with the same acquisition-derived executable capability, activated only through scoped runtime applicability checks and verifier gates.

primary_endpoint_denominator: all protected case-arm evaluations with a competence outcome; infrastructure errors are excluded from the repair denominator and reported separately as coverage/infrastructure error rate
repair_success_rule: The candidate patch must make the frozen BugsInPy regression test pass on the pinned buggy commit under the task environment. Infrastructure errors are not repair failures.
false_activation_rule: An activation is false when an arm applies acquisition-derived capability to a protected task outside its frozen applicability contract or when the verifier rejects the resulting intervention as inapplicable.
stopping_rule: Attempt every frozen qualified protected case exactly once in each arm, then stop.
infrastructure_policy: Record provisioning, dependency, network, timeout, checkout, and unreproducible-test failures separately from competence outcomes.
